name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new feature for FusionAuth

---

> **Paid license or support contract?** Please bring suspected issues and feature requests to our support team in the [account portal](https://account.fusionauth.io/account/support/) or email [support@fusionauth.io](mailto:support@fusionauth.io).

### Problem
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Ex. I'm always frustrated when [...]

### Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

### Alternatives/workarounds
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered.

### Additional context
Add any other context or screenshots about the feature request here.

### Community guidelines
All issues filed in this repository must abide by the [FusionAuth community guidelines](https://fusionauth.io/community/forum/topic/1000/code-of-conduct).

### How to vote
Please give us a thumbs up or thumbs down as a reaction to help us prioritize this feature. Feel free to comment if you have a particular need or comment on how this feature should work.
